user.title: Home Desk
user.description: An issue tracker for your smart home, for the manager, the household and AI agents.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Desk is already set up.

get_guide.name: Get guide
get_guide.description: START HERE if you are an AI agent. Returns the usage guide for Home Desk: what it is, ticket fields and statuses, how to review, comment on, update and close tickets, and conventions to follow.

get_changelog.name: Get changelog
get_changelog.description: Return the installed Home Desk version and its changelog: what changed, and any **Action:** or **Breaking:** notes. Pass `since` (the last version you reviewed) to get only newer releases. Call after Home Desk is updated.

since.name: Since version
since.description: Only include releases newer than this version. The Unreleased section is always included.

list_tags.name: List tags
list_tags.description: Return every tag with its id, name, colour and how many tickets use it. Prefer an existing tag over inventing a new one; a tag name you use that doesn't exist is created automatically.

get_stats.name: Get stats
get_stats.description: Return ticket counts by status, urgent and unassigned counts, and every tag (with colour and count). A good first call to see what needs attention.

list_tickets.name: List tickets
list_tickets.description: List ticket summaries (no bodies); use get_ticket for the full ticket. Defaults to active tickets, excluding history. Tag `needs-review` marks tickets whose state has not been verified yet.

status.name: Status
status.description: A status, a comma-separated list, `active` (new, open, in_progress, waiting; the default) or `all`.

query.name: Query
query.description: Search text across title, description, comments, resolution, tags and entities.

requester.name: Requester
requester.description: Only tickets raised by this person.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Only tickets with this tag (name or id).

get_ticket.name: Get ticket
get_ticket.description: Return one ticket in full: description, resolution, tags, entities, timeline of comments and changes, and related tickets.

create_ticket.name: Create ticket
create_ticket.description: Create a ticket and return it. Search first (list_tickets with a query) to avoid duplicates. AI agents: call get_guide first and pass `actor` with your own name.

title.name: Title
title.description: Short summary of the problem, request or idea.

description.name: Description
description.description: Details in markdown: what happened, evidence, what was expected.

type.name: Type
type.description: issue, request, idea, task, question or log (history record).

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: low, normal, high or urgent (urgent = safety, security or whole-house outage).

requester.name: Requester
requester.description: Who raised it. Defaults to the actor.

assignee.name: Assignee
assignee.description: Who should work on it. Leave empty for unassigned.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tag names or ids. Names that don't exist yet are created. Defaults to Home Assistant when omitted.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Home Assistant entity ids this ticket concerns.

actor.name: Actor
actor.description: Who is acting, recorded on the timeline. AI agents: pass your own name (e.g. claude), otherwise the token owner's name is recorded.

update_ticket.name: Update ticket
update_ticket.description: Change a ticket's fields. Pass only what should change; every change is logged on the timeline. To close a ticket use close_ticket so a resolution is recorded.

status.name: Status
status.description: new, open, in_progress, waiting, resolved or closed.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Replace all tags with this list.

add_tags.name: Add tags
add_tags.description: Tag names or ids to add. Unknown names are created.

remove_tags.name: Remove tags
remove_tags.description: Tag names or ids to remove.

actor.name: Actor
actor.description: Who is acting, recorded on the timeline. AI agents: pass your own name (e.g. claude), otherwise the token owner's name is recorded.

add_comment.name: Add comment
add_comment.description: Add a comment to a ticket's timeline. Use it to record findings: what you checked, what you found, with times and values.

internal.name: Internal note
internal.description: True makes a private note that the requester can't see.

actor.name: Actor
actor.description: Who is acting, recorded on the timeline. AI agents: pass your own name (e.g. claude), otherwise the token owner's name is recorded.

close_ticket.name: Close ticket
close_ticket.description: Resolve or close a ticket with resolution notes (the cause and the fix). Only close when you are confident; otherwise comment and leave it open.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.description: What the cause was and what fixed it.

status.name: Status
status.description: `resolved` (fixed; the default) or `closed` (won't fix, superseded or no longer relevant).

actor.name: Actor
actor.description: Who is acting, recorded on the timeline. AI agents: pass your own name (e.g. claude), otherwise the token owner's name is recorded.

link_tickets.name: Link tickets
link_tickets.description: Mark two tickets as related; shown on both.

actor.name: Actor
actor.description: Who is acting, recorded on the timeline. AI agents: pass your own name (e.g. claude), otherwise the token owner's name is recorded.

import_file.name: Import file
import_file.description: Admin: bulk-import tickets from a JSON file inside the config directory. Idempotent: tickets whose source_key already exists are skipped.

path.name: Path
path.description: Path to the JSON file, inside the Home Assistant config directory.
